headline: 839 hospitalised in 24 hours as 5 more die of dengue
summary: Single-day hospitalisations hit a yearly high while total deaths rise to 82, with experts warning cases may climb through October.
details: At least five dengue patients died and 839 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours ending yesterday morning. This marks the highest single-day hospitalisation count recorded so far this year.

Of the deceased, three were from Dhaka South City Corporation, while one each was from the Dhaka and Khulna divisions. The total number of dengue deaths has now risen to 82, with overall cases reaching 28,929.

Currently, 1,951 dengue patients are receiving treatment in hospitals across the country. Prof Kabirul Bashar of Jahangirnagar University suggests cases will likely continue to rise through October before declining in November.

Experts recommend identifying dengue hotspots at the neighbourhood level and intensifying mosquito control and community awareness. National efforts should focus on source reduction and larviciding to curb breeding.

Medical professionals advise patients to seek evaluations at the onset of fever, on the third or fourth day, and after the fever subsides. Immediate attention is critical if warning signs like severe abdominal pain or breathing difficulties appear.

headline_marked: CCTV footage shows [[thieves steal all goods]] from a shop
headline: CCTV footage shows thieves steal all goods from a shop
summary: A shocking video captures the moment burglars cleared out a store, leaving the owner with significant losses.
details: CCTV footage has emerged showing a group of thieves breaking into a shop and stealing all the merchandise.
The video captures the burglars systematically clearing out the store's inventory, leaving nothing behind.
The shop owner reported a total loss of all goods, highlighting the brazen nature of the theft.
Authorities are investigating the incident using the captured footage to identify and track down the suspects.
